title: Revit Adjacent Interoperability Source Inventory
purpose: Separate cross-tool interoperability sources that mention Revit from Appendix E Revit implementation standards.

assets.title: S9 — Inventor to Revit Data Exchange Governance
assets.notes: Defines exchange authority boundaries, scope, acceptance criteria, traceability and change handling. Explicitly excludes click-by-click instructions. Inventor remains authoritative for manufacturing geometry; Revit is authoritative for BIM context/documentation; governed CDE publication controls accepted exchange packages.

assets.title: Inventor to Revit Export Workflow JSON
assets.notes: Governed assisted workflow for choosing RVT versus RFA, preparing/simplifying source content, executing export, validating in Revit and recording evidence.

assets.title: Inventor to Revit Export Instruction Set JSON
assets.notes: Nine atomic instructions I6.3.001–I6.3.009 cover export intent, simplification, model-state selection, RVT/RFA settings, execution, Revit validation, update verification and metadata logging.

assets.title: Exporting Inventor Models to Revit
assets.notes: Narrative guidance supporting the W6.3 workflow/instruction set.

boundary: These assets are adjacent to Revit but are not part of the 13-topic Appendix E style-guide family.
The S9 governance object states what must be true across the tool boundary; W6.3 coordinates the process; IS-W6.3 executes the detailed steps.
Source-specific export-setting examples must remain source facts until reviewed; extraction does not promote them into universal Revit presets.
The cross-tool chain should later map to S7 exchange and S9 tool-authority governance without duplicating Appendix E content.

provenance.migration_note: Direct source inventory only; no canonical promotion.
